messages:
Nina: Quick sync  proposal: surface SLO alert rules in Console as "Alert cards" showing threshold, notify targets, and current suppression/quota state. Need decisions on routing precedence and quota semantics.
Omar: Love the cards. Routing precedence we discussed before: tenant-configured -> policy-assigned -> global-default. Important to show "why" in the UI when fallback happens.
Priya: Agree. On quotas: we should enforce soft quotas (sampling) and hard quotas (drop) for extreme cases. Soft quota emits `slo.notify.sampled` and reduces traffic; hard quota emits `slo.notify.dropped` and stops sends.
Nina: Can we have a single API that returns both configured + effective view? Something like: `GET /api/console/slo/{id}/notify` -> plain JSON with `configured_targets`, `effective_target`, `quota_state`. UI can show both and highlight differences.
Omar: Implementation note: effective_target calculation depends on routing policies and contact health (webhook 5xx/429). If contact unhealthy, we mark and fallback. Also include `last_health_check` timestamp.
Priya: Telemetry: counters we need: `slo.notify.total`, `slo.notify.sent`, `slo.notify.sampled`, `slo.notify.dropped`, `slo.notify.fallback`. All should be labelable by tenant, route, and policy. Also gauge `slo.notify.quota_remaining{tenant}`.
infra-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2048 adds /api/console/slo notify endpoint + metrics.
Nina: UI UX: show a small breadcrumb on the card: Configured -> Policy -> Effective, with hover text explaining fallback reason. Also a tiny "Preview" button to send a sanitized test payload.
ui-bot: Note: preview should replace secrets and use a sandbox webhook. Logs retained for 3 days only (security request).
Omar: For canary, plan: feature-flag console_notify_cards_v1, enable for 8% tenants, run 72h. Canary checks: < 20% sampling rate, no increase in webhook 429s > baseline.
Priya: Add alert: if `slo.notify.dropped` > 0 for > 5 tenants within 1h, page oncall. We should also surface tenant-level suppression heatmap in dashboard.
Nina: Migration: existing notify-preview will read `configured_targets` as before. We'll keep legacy path until flag off. Compat shim in API layer returns legacy shape when `legacy_preview=true`.
Omar: Edge case: route-level policies that reference deleted contact ids. We should log fallback reason `missing_contact` and include `audit_id` for operators.
Priya: Rate-limiting detail: sampling strategy should be deterministic per-alert-id so we can reproduce counts in telemetry. Use hash(alert_id, tenant_id) and bucket.
infra-bot: dry-run endpoint: POST /internal/notify/preview -> returns payload and route decision. Accessible to admins only.
Nina: Who owns what? Omar27s team will add quota enforcement + metrics. Priya will spec sampling algorithm. I'll own product & rollout checklist and the console card designs.
Omar: I'll add a dashboard tile: "Notify health (canary)" showing sent/sampled/dropped stacked by tenant.
Priya: One more: audit: every fallback and quota enforcement must write an audit entry with reason, tenant, request-id. Retain 90d.
Nina: Great. I'll schedule a short sync tomorrow to go over the checklist. Thanks everyone :rocket:
